rec.name: PDP Compare Products Table (Compare with Our Other Products)
rec.status: Built — delivered by dev (July 2025); documentation reviewed, product image supplied

what.text: A PDP section that shows 2–4 of the store's own products side by side in a horizontal, symmetric comparison table. Each column has a product image, name, short description, price and up to 5 technical bullet points. The product currently being viewed is marked "This model" (accent label plus underline), so shoppers see where it sits in the range. Optional subheading, heading and download button (e.g. PDF data sheet). The section hides itself on products without comparison data.

why.text: Comparing within the range reduces choice uncertainty. Shoppers can check that the product fits their needs without leaving for a competitor's site. Anchoring on "this model" makes the higher- and lower-priced siblings read as reference points. This enables confident upsell (a better model) or downsell (a cheaper one) instead of a bounce. Aligned rows of specs make differences scannable, which lowers cognitive load for technical, higher-consideration products. Inference: the buyer-psychology rationale is not stated in the ticket.

how.text: Built as a custom Shopify section (file ed-dynamic-compare.liquid) with blocks: Subheading, Heading and Product card (up to 4 cards). The comparison content is driven by three product metafields created by the dev, so values can differ per product. The section stays hidden when those metafields are empty. Layout is a symmetric table-like grid with aligned name, description, price and bullet rows. On mobile the products stack or scroll horizontally; the screenshot shows the row overflowing with the 4th column cut off, which suggests horizontal scroll. The current product is flagged via a per-product setting (checkbox in the Customizer per the ticket) and styled with a secondary accent colour. An optional download button (top right) has configurable text, icon and link. Style variables are exposed as CSS custom properties per section ID. The code file is truncated, so the exact metafield names and the Liquid markup of the table are not visible.

items: Headline (free text) with font size, colour, alignment and desktop/mobile variants
Subheadline (optional) with font size, colour, alignment
Comparison products: min. 2, max. 4, each with image, name, short description, price, up to 5 bullet points
Per-product checkbox to mark it as "This model"
Optional download button top right: text, icon, link target (e.g. PDF data sheet)
Section background colour, text colour, divider line colour
Secondary/accent colour for the current-product marker
Custom max-width toggle and max-width slider (default 1750 px in screenshot)
Section spacing top/bottom/left/right (desktop) and separate mobile spacing
Table background colour and table corner radius (from code)
Highlighted/underlined word in the heading (visible in screenshot; likely a heading option)
Theme settings and Custom CSS panels

dependencies.text: Three product metafields (names not specified in the source) hold the comparison values per product; the section is hidden when they are not set. Requires a theme that supports custom sections and uses global theme colour settings (settings.heading_color, settings.background) as fallbacks. Product images must be supplied per comparison product. No third-party app is named; the editor screenshot shows the section built in a Sectionfy.io test store. Source code and install guide are in the attached TXT file and a Slite doc.

items: PDP conversion rate for products showing the section vs. control
Click-through rate to compared products (if linked)
Add-to-cart rate and revenue per visitor on PDP
AOV / share of upsell to higher-priced model
Bounce and exit rate on PDP

images.caption: Reference design (Bowers & Wilkins): subheading and heading, "Dieses Modell" label with accent underline over the current product, three aligned columns with image, name, description, price and bullet specs separated by thin lines.

Final Shopify build in the theme editor: Subheading, Heading and Product card blocks; "This model" marker on the first card; 4th column overflowing horizontally; right panel with max-width, colours and desktop/mobile spacing settings.
Section structure in the template sidebar (PDP | Compare Products with Subheading, Heading, Product card blocks) shows how it is assembled.
